recommended_controls.title: Prohibited and restricted AI use policy
recommended_controls.objective: Define prohibited, restricted and conditionally permitted AI uses and screen every use case against them.

recommended_controls.title: Enterprise AI inventory (system of record)
recommended_controls.objective: Maintain a complete, current inventory of AI systems, models, agents and vendor AI products in a single system of record.
evidence: AI inventory export with record counts

recommended_controls.title: Accountable owner per AI system
recommended_controls.objective: Assign a named accountable business owner and technical owner to every AI system.

recommended_controls.title: Privacy assessment and data minimisation
recommended_controls.objective: Assess privacy, consent, retention, cross-border transfer and minimisation requirements for AI processing of personal data.

recommended_controls.title: Human oversight design
recommended_controls.objective: Design human review, override, escalation and appeal mechanisms proportionate to decision impact.

recommended_controls.title: Least-privilege tool access
recommended_controls.objective: Grant AI agents only the tools, scopes and data access required for their declared purpose; deny by default.

recommended_controls.title: Evidence repository and retention
recommended_controls.objective: Store governance evidence in a controlled repository with retention aligned to obligations.

recommended_controls.title: Pre-deployment risk and impact assessment
recommended_controls.objective: Complete a documented risk and impact assessment, proportionate to risk tier, before production deployment.

recommended_controls.title: Risk-tiered approval gates
recommended_controls.objective: Require approvals by authorities proportionate to risk tier before deployment, with recorded conditions.

recommended_controls.title: Sensitive data redaction and masking
recommended_controls.objective: Redact, mask or exclude sensitive data from prompts, responses, logs and external model calls.

recommended_controls.title: Prompt-injection and data-leakage testing
recommended_controls.objective: Test LLM applications and agents for prompt injection, jailbreak, data leakage and unsafe tool use before release and after material change.

recommended_controls.title: Kill switch and rollback
recommended_controls.objective: Be able to disable or roll back an AI system, model, agent, tool or tenant quickly after a security or safety incident.

recommended_controls.title: Immutable action logging
recommended_controls.objective: Log AI decisions, tool calls, policy decisions and approvals in tamper-evident, retained logs.

recommended_controls.title: AI literacy and role-based training
recommended_controls.owner_role: HR / Learning lead with AI Governance Lead
recommended_controls.objective: Provide role-based AI literacy and responsible-use training for staff, operators and decision-makers.

recommended_controls.title: Escalation paths and decision rights
recommended_controls.objective: Define how AI issues, concerns and incidents are escalated, to whom, and within what timeframe.

recommended_controls.title: Regulatory and contractual obligations register
recommended_controls.objective: Maintain a register of AI-relevant legal, regulatory, contractual and customer obligations by jurisdiction and system.
evidence: Mapping of obligations to AI systems

recommended_controls.title: Intended purpose and context of use
recommended_controls.objective: Document intended purpose, users, affected parties, context of use and foreseeable misuse for each AI system.

recommended_controls.title: Model, prompt and component registry
recommended_controls.objective: Record models, versions, prompts, system instructions, fine-tunes and configuration for each AI system.

recommended_controls.title: Data source and lineage registry
recommended_controls.objective: Record data sources, classifications, provenance and data flows used to train, ground or operate each AI system.

recommended_controls.title: Third-party and vendor AI inventory
recommended_controls.objective: Inventory vendor AI products, embedded AI features and foundation-model providers with contract and data-processing details.

recommended_controls.title: Change management and reassessment triggers
recommended_controls.objective: Subject model, prompt, data, vendor, tool and agent changes to change control and trigger reassessment when material.

recommended_controls.title: Technical documentation
recommended_controls.objective: Maintain technical documentation describing design, data, performance, limitations and controls for each material AI system.

recommended_controls.title: Vendor AI due diligence and contract controls
recommended_controls.objective: Perform AI-specific due diligence on vendors and include AI terms (data use, model changes, incident notice, audit rights) in contracts.

recommended_controls.title: AI threat modelling
recommended_controls.objective: Threat-model AI systems, including prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction and unsafe tool use.

recommended_controls.title: Data governance and quality
recommended_controls.objective: Govern the quality, representativeness and fitness of data used to train, fine-tune or ground AI systems.

recommended_controls.title: Bias and fairness testing
recommended_controls.objective: Test AI systems for bias and discriminatory outcomes across relevant groups before release and periodically.

recommended_controls.title: Safety and harm evaluation
recommended_controls.objective: Evaluate AI systems for safety risks and unintended harms to individuals, groups and society.

recommended_controls.title: Accuracy and robustness testing
recommended_controls.objective: Measure accuracy and robustness, including degraded and adversarial conditions, against declared levels.

recommended_controls.title: Transparency and AI disclosures
recommended_controls.objective: Inform users when they interact with AI or when AI materially influences a decision, and provide explanations where appropriate.

recommended_controls.title: Secure model and prompt supply chain
recommended_controls.objective: Secure models, weights, prompts, plugins and dependencies against tampering and untrusted sources.

recommended_controls.title: Runtime guardrails and policy enforcement
recommended_controls.objective: Evaluate prompts, responses and tool calls against versioned runtime policy before execution.

recommended_controls.title: AI incident management and reporting
recommended_controls.objective: Detect, triage, contain, report and learn from AI incidents, including regulatory notification where required.

recommended_controls.title: Audit-ready evidence packs
recommended_controls.objective: Produce an audit-ready evidence pack for any material AI system on request.

recommended_controls.title: Third-party AI accountability
recommended_controls.objective: Assign accountability for vendor and third-party AI, including allocation of responsibilities between provider, deployer and customer.
evidence: Responsibility allocation (e.g. RACI or contract schedule)

recommended_controls.title: Rate, budget and resource limits
recommended_controls.objective: Enforce rate, token, cost and tool-call limits to contain runaway agents, abuse and denial-of-wallet.

recommended_controls.title: AI risk classification and tiering
recommended_controls.objective: Classify every AI system by business criticality, data sensitivity, decision impact, autonomy and regulatory relevance and assign a risk tier.

recommended_controls.title: Human approval for high-impact actions
recommended_controls.objective: Require designated human approval before AI agents execute high-impact, irreversible or external actions.

recommended_controls.title: Use-case intake register
recommended_controls.objective: Capture every proposed AI use case through a standard intake before build or procurement.

recommended_controls.title: Intake triage workflow
recommended_controls.objective: Triage each intake against risk triggers to route it to the right assessment depth and approvers.

recommended_controls.title: Pre-release validation and testing
recommended_controls.objective: Validate performance, robustness and safety against acceptance criteria before release.

recommended_controls.title: Deployment conditions and go-live readiness
recommended_controls.objective: Verify that approval conditions, monitoring, oversight and rollback are in place before go-live.

recommended_controls.title: Post-deployment monitoring
recommended_controls.objective: Monitor production AI systems for performance, drift, misuse, incidents and unexpected behaviour with defined thresholds.

recommended_controls.title: Model performance and drift monitoring
recommended_controls.objective: Monitor model performance and data/concept drift against thresholds and trigger review when breached.

recommended_controls.title: Stakeholder engagement and feedback
recommended_controls.objective: Collect and act on feedback from affected individuals, users and internal stakeholders about AI systems.

recommended_controls.title: Inventory attestation and recertification
recommended_controls.objective: Require owners to periodically attest that inventory records are complete and accurate.

recommended_controls.title: Periodic review and recertification
recommended_controls.objective: Re-review AI systems at a cadence set by risk tier and recertify continued use.
